typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ReceiptReason as string,
		SubscriberId as string,
		Amount as decimal(19,19),
		PaymentType as string,
		PayMethod as string,
		VendorRefId as string,
		CheckNum as string,
		DepositeDate as timestamp,
		GroupId as string,
		BillingGroupId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'exec Refund.pr_CreateExcelFile ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of PayMethod} = toString(PayMethod),
		{Copy of BillingGroupId} = toString(BillingGroupId),
		{Copy of CheckNum} = toString(CheckNum),
		{Copy of ReceiptReason} = toString(ReceiptReason),
		{Copy of SubscriberId} = toString(SubscriberId),
		{Copy of VendorRefId} = toString(VendorRefId),
		{Copy of GroupId} = toString(GroupId),
		{Copy of PaymentType} = toString(PaymentType)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
